Myths on Clay tells the Hawaiian myths in the style of kapa cloth and lava-rock petroglyphs, one story at a time, in the order the old chants tell them.
Sources: the Kumulipo (tr. Martha Beckwith; Queen Liliʻuokalani), Martha Beckwith's Hawaiian Mythology, Abraham Fornander, Samuel Kamakau, Nathaniel Emerson's Pele and Hiʻiaka, Mary Kawena Pukui.
Narrated by Matías.
